Using the earliest plausible start - the letter's own date, Sat 21.11.2026 - as the day of receipt: under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt is not counted, so counting starts 22.11.2026. Three months later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) lands on Sun 21.02.2027. This is a notice/termination period, which under settled case law (BGH III ZR 172/04) does NOT shift to the next business day when it falls on a weekend or holiday - the notice must still arrive by that calendar day.
